messages:
Aisha: Kicking off Blue Harbor onboarding — sharing timeline, roles, and a short checklist. Link to internal kickoff doc: https://redwood.internal/blue-harbor-kickoff. Quick asks: who can own weekly enablement sessions? Target pilot go-live ~6 weeks.
Jamal: I can own enablement and pair on SE sessions. Q: are we planning a sample data ingest in week 1 or week 2?
Olivia: Product confirms week 2 for full sample ingest; we'd like a small sample earlier if possible. Need data schema by Wed.
Kai: I can help with infra and capacity sizing. If they want predictable throughput we should discuss Dedicated sizing.
Aisha: Good — proposed checklist (high level):
  - sample data drop (week 1 small, week 2 full)
  - API keys & firewall rules whitelisting (week 1–2)
  - onboarding workshop + hands-on (week 3)
  - pilot run + metrics collection (week 4–5)
  - renewal & success review (week 6)
Jamal: Risk to call out: pilot latency spike could affect renewal sentiment. Suggest canary fallback to a smaller model if p95 > 500ms.
Nina: I'll own feedback capture. Plan: short post-workshop survey + weekly pilot health check. I'll reuse our feedback template: https://redwood.internal/templates/onboard-feedback.
Olivia: For success criteria propose: 1) functional correctness for 95% of test prompts, 2) p95 latency < 350ms, 3) pilot adoption >= 60% of target query volume.
Kai: Got it. For Dedicated sizing we should estimate peak QPS — what do we expect?
Aisha: Customer said peak ~120 rps during business hours. Jamal, can you confirm sample traffic patterns?
Jamal: Confirming — will provide jsonl sample and traffic histogram. I'll upload sample to our S3 bucket by Tue EOD.
Aisha: Perfect. Action owners summary: Jamal (data + SE), Kai (infra / Dedicated ask), Nina (feedback + enablement logistics), Aisha (CS lead + renewal contact). Weekly sync: Tuesdays 11:00 AM PT starting next week.
Kai: Please share the workshop deck early — I can do a quick pre-run on Thu.
Nina: I'll prepare the post-workshop survey (NPS + 3 free-text prompts) and a short checklist for enablement attendees.
Aisha: I'll open a Dedicated scoping ticket and tag eng-runtime + eng-platform for capacity questions, and post the full onboarding playbook later today. :thumbsup:
Redwood Deploy Bot: recurring meeting created — Tuesdays 11:00 AM PT (invite sent).
Olivia: Thanks everyone, excited to get this moving.
